message.content: {"decision":"PROPOSE","observations":["Both source questions fix an ordered sequence of operands and binary operators (+,-,*) and allow only full parenthesization (inserting parentheses) without reordering operands or operators.","The requested quantity is the number of distinct numerical values obtainable over all full binary parenthesizations of the fixed expression.","The interface supplies operands (integers) and operators (length = len(operands)-1), matching the fixed expression structure.","The mathematical core is: enumerate all full binary tree parenthesizations of the operator sequence, evaluate each under standard integer arithmetic, and count distinct results.","Duplicate values must be deduplicated; the count is of distinct values, not parenthesizations.","No semantic routing or task-ID dependence is needed; the procedure is purely combinatorial over the parameter arrays."],"procedure_plan":"Implement solve(parameters): read operands o[0..n-1] and operators op[0..n-2]. Use interval dynamic programming: for each subinterval [i,j] of operands, compute the set S[i][j] of all values obtainable by fully parenthesizing o[i..j] with operators op[i..j-1]. Base case S[i][i] = {o[i]}. For length L from 2 to n, for each i with j=i+L-1, for each split k in [i, j-1], combine every a in S[i][k] and b in S[k+1][j] using op[k]: if '+' add, if '-' subtract, if '*' multiply; insert results into S[i][j]. Return the cardinality of S[0][n-1]. Use exact integer arithmetic; sets handle deduplication. Complexity is O(n^3 * max set size), acceptable for n<=8.","uncertainty":"Set sizes can grow but are bounded for n<=8 and small integer operands; no overflow concerns with standard integers. The procedure assumes standard precedence is irrelevant because all parenthesizations are enumerated, which matches the source framing. If the intended semantics required preserving default precedence rather than full parenthesization, the count would differ, but the source text explicitly allows inserting parentheses anywhere, so full parenthesization is the correct interpretation.","invalid_operation":null,"replacement_operation":null}
